notes.sowing: Start seeds indoors 6 to 8 weeks before you plan to plant out, {cm:0.6} deep, at {c:21} to {c:27}. Plant out once nights stay above {c:10}, burying the stem up to the first true leaves.
notes.care: Stake or cage at planting. Water deeply and evenly to prevent blossom-end rot, and mulch once the soil is warm. On staked vining types, pinch out side shoots.
notes.harvest: Pick when fully colored and slightly soft. Before the first fall frost, pick mature green fruit and ripen it indoors.
